key.hotbar_utils.restock.tooltip: Restocks the selected slot from the inventory.
key.hotbar_utils.quick_elytra.tooltip: Swaps elytra with chestplate from inventory and vice-versa
config.hotbar_utils.title: Hotbar Utils Settings
config.hotbar_utils.slot.type.tooltip: Controls whether Hotbar Utils grabs from inventory or equipment.
config.hotbar_utils.slot.overlay.tooltip: Displays a number overlay on top of the slot HUD. Set to 0 to disable.
config.hotbar_utils.render_unbound.toolt: True: Renders back slots even when the corresponding hotkeys are unbound.
config.hotbar_utils.offhand_texture.tool: Displays back slots with the offhand frame texture.
config.hotbar_utils.hud_spacing.tooltip: Spacing in between each back slot.
config.hotbar_utils.hud_anchor.tooltip: Selects which side of the hotbar the back slots will be displayed.
config.hotbar_utils.hud_anchor_type.tool: DYNAMIC: Empty Slots will not be shown. STATIC: All slots will be shown.
config.hotbar_utils.elytra.fallback.tool: Equip first item if preferred equipment is not found.
config.hotbar_utils.elytra.elytra_name.t: Optional. Chooses elytra with specified name, if available.
config.hotbar_utils.elytra.chestplate_ty: Optional: Chooses chestplate with specified type, if available. EX: minecraft:iron_chestplate
config.hotbar_utils.elytra.chestplate_na: Optional: Chooses chestplate with specified name, if available.
